nvitk.db¶

Dataset catalog, SQLite index, XNAT helpers, imports, and DataRepo.

Configure the tree with NVITK_DATASET_ROOT or pass root= to DataRepo.

Create a minimal dataset tree at root by copying the packaged catalog templates (manifests + schema) and creating empty tables//cache/ directories.

Re-read all manifest JSON files from disk and rebuild the in-memory TableDefinition cache. Called after every catalog mutation to keep this instance consistent with disk.

Absolute path to the directory holding this dataset’s Parquet table files.

Sorted names of every table registered in the manifest.

Return name’s TableDefinition, raising TableNotFoundError if unregistered.

table_exists(name: str) → bool¶

True if name is a registered table.

ensure_table_definition(name: str, *, clone_from: str) → pathlib.Path¶

Register name in tables.json by cloning manifest metadata from clone_from, pointing at <table_root>/{name}.parquet. Creates an empty Parquet file if missing.

No-op (returns existing Parquet path) when name is already registered.

The pipeline_id flagged is_default for modality, or None if none is set.

pipeline_id values for every pipeline entry tagged with role.

Set of every registered pipeline_id across all modalities.

Pipeline entries for modality (case-insensitive), or all entries if modality is unset.

static _normalize_pipeline_tokens(selector: str | int | Iterable[str | int] | None) → list[str]¶

Coerce a pipeline selector (a single str/int or an iterable of them) into a flat list of non-empty stripped string tokens.

resolve_pipeline_selector(selector: str | int | Iterable[str | int] | None, *, modality: str | None = None) → list[str] | None¶

Return None to apply catalog defaults per modality in DataRepo.image. Otherwise return an explicit pipeline_id list.

Aliases from measurement_pipelines.json (including integers like 1 / 2) resolve within the pipelines for modality when provided; without modality, ambiguous aliases raise ManifestError.

validate_pipelines_manifest(payload: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Validate the pipelines manifest structure and reject duplicate is_default pipelines within the same modality; raises ManifestError on any violation.

variable_entries(*, domain: str | None = None, table: str | None = None) → list[dict[str, Any]]¶

Registered variable entries, optionally filtered by domain and/or table.

resolve_variable_ids(requested: str | Iterable[str] | None, *, domain: str | None = None) → list[str]¶

Resolve requested names/aliases/source-column names/labels to canonical variable_id values (case- and normalization-insensitive), leaving any unmatched entries unchanged.

register_variables(entries: list[dict[str, Any]], *, merge: bool = True) → None¶

Add or update entries in the variables manifest (merging into existing entries with the same variable_id when merge is True, otherwise overwriting), then persist and reload.

_merge_variable_entry(existing: dict[str, Any], new: dict[str, Any]) → dict[str, Any]¶

Merge new onto existing: union+de-dupe aliases, and for every other key skip empty strings/lists/None in new so a partial update never blanks out existing metadata.

update_table_schema(name: str, df: pandas.DataFrame, *, provenance: dict[str, Any] | None = None, path: str | None = None) → None¶

Update (or create) name’s entry in the tables manifest from df’s inferred dtypes, row count, and optional provenance/path, then persist and reload.

clear_table(name: str) → None¶

Delete the Parquet file for name if present and set row_count to 0 in the manifest.

validate_repository_manifest(payload: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Raise ManifestError if payload is missing any REQUIRED_REPOSITORY_KEYS.

validate_tables_manifest(payload: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Raise ManifestError if payload’s tables object or any entry is malformed.

validate_variables_manifest(payload: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Raise ManifestError if payload lacks a variables list, or if any entry is invalid.

_validate_variable_entry(entry: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Raise ManifestError/ValidationError if entry is missing required keys or has a blank variable_id.

nvitk.db.build_clinical_measurement_rows(agg: pandas.DataFrame, spec: DerivedClinicalMeasurementSpec) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Map an aggregate frame to clinical_measurements columns (one derived variable).

As with the image builder, a categorical / text spec.value_kind routes the value to value_text rather than value_num.

nvitk.db.build_image_measurement_rows(agg: pandas.DataFrame, spec: DerivedImageMeasurementSpec) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Map an aggregate frame to image_measurements columns (one derived variable).

agg must include subject_uid and the column named by spec.value_column. Optional columns copied through when present: session_id, region_id, region_label, frame_index. A categorical / text spec.value_kind routes the value to value_text instead of value_num (see _split_values()).

Upsert derived measurement rows and optionally register catalog metadata.

Pass the dataframe returned by build_image_measurement_rows() or build_clinical_measurement_rows() (the latter also matches the cognitive_measurements schema). When register is set, that entry is written with register_derived_variable() after a successful upsert.

Import a single named file from db_base_path, resolving it against the configured PESA-Brain source specs (optionally narrowed by sheet/source_kind when a filename maps to more than one spec). Enrolls any resulting subjects into cohort_id and, unless rebuild_subjects is False, refreshes the subjects table. Raises FileNotFoundError if the directory or file is missing, and ValueError if the filename matches zero or multiple specs.

class nvitk.db.DataRepo(root: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, *, use_sqlite: bool = True, auto_scaffold: bool = False)¶

Dataset-facing API: load tables, clinical/image measurements, assets, scans, and writes.

Queries prefer the SQLite index when use_sqlite is True and the index file exists; otherwise fall back to Parquet. Cohort filtering uses cohort_membership when present unless cohort_id=False (disable) or an explicit cohort id is passed.

root¶
catalog¶
sqlite¶
use_sqlite = True¶

Registered table names from the catalog manifest.

Return (effective_cohort, filters_without_cohort_id). False = do not filter by cohort.

_cohort_subject_uid_set(cohort_id: str) → set[str] | None¶

Subjects in cohort_membership for cohort_id; None if table missing or empty (no filtering).

_filter_dataframe_by_cohort(df: pandas.DataFrame, cohort_id: str) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Restrict df to rows whose subject_uid belongs to cohort_id; no-op if cohort membership is unavailable or df has no subject_uid column.

_measurement_column_names(table_name: str) → set[str]¶

Column names declared in the catalog manifest for table_name.

_split_measurement_filters(filters: dict[str, Any] | None, *, domain: str, table_name: str) → tuple[dict[str, Any], list[tuple[str, Any]], dict[str, str]]¶

Split a user-supplied filters dict into structural column filters (applied directly to the measurement table) and per-variable value filters (applied against value_num/value_text rows for a specific variable_id), resolving any variable aliases along the way. Returns (structural_filters, [(variable_id, spec), ...], canonical_to_alias).

_rename_measurement_wide_columns(df: pandas.DataFrame, *, table_name: str, canonical_to_alias: dict[str, str]) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Rename wide-pivot columns from canonical variable ids back to the aliases the caller requested (image-measurement columns via suffix rewriting, other tables via a direct column rename).

_load_table_frame(table: str, *, columns: list[str] | None = None, filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None, use_sqlite: bool | None = True, force_parquet: bool = False) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Load table via SQLite (if enabled/available) with a Parquet fallback on query failure, coercing the result to the manifest’s declared column dtypes.

get(table: str, *, columns: list[str] | None = None, filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None, wide: bool = False, use_sqlite: bool | None = True, cohort_id: str | bool | None = None) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Load table as a DataFrame with optional column projection, filters, and wide pivot.

For clinical_measurements / image_measurements / cognitive_measurements, wide=True resolves values and pivots to one column per variable (and entity keys); see catalog wide definitions.

cognitive(*, variables: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None, wide: bool = True, use_sqlite: bool | None = True, cohort_id: str | bool | None = None) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Query cognitive_measurements like clinical() but with domain='cognitive'.

clinical(*, variables: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None, wide: bool = True, use_sqlite: bool | None = True, cohort_id: str | bool | None = None) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Query clinical_measurements with variable resolution, optional value filters, and cohort scope.

Non-reserved filters keys are treated as variable ids with comparison specs (see apply_filters()). Set wide=False for long (tidy) form.

image(*, modality: str | None = None, variables: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, regions: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, atlas: str | None = None, filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None, wide: bool = True, use_sqlite: bool | None = True, pipeline: str | int | Iterable[str | int] | None = None, cohort_id: str | bool | None = None) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Query image_measurements with modality, regions, atlas (ASL or T1), pipeline selection, and filters.

When neither modality nor pipeline filters are given, rows are restricted to catalog default pipelines per modality where defined. Use atlas= with modality='asl' or modality='t1' to expand regions from a named atlas preset.

_filter_image_rows_to_catalog_defaults(df: pandas.DataFrame) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Keep rows where each modality with a catalog default matches that pipeline_id; other modalities pass through.

_assets_to_wide(df: pandas.DataFrame, *, value_column: str = 'asset_path') → pandas.DataFrame¶

One row per subject_uid; column names are asset_slot values (paths in cells by default).

assets(*, filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None, modality: str | None = None, asset_type: str | None = None, resource_label: str | None = None, subject_uid: str | None = None, session_uid: str | None = None, pipeline_id: str | None = None, asset_slot: str | None = None, source: str | None = None, wide: bool = False, use_sqlite: bool | None = True, value: str = 'asset_path', get_image: bool = False, imread_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None, cohort_id: str | bool | None = None) → pandas.DataFrame | Any¶

Query the assets table; optionally pivot to one row per subject_uid (wide=True).

With get_image=True, resolve paths to nvitk.io.imageio.imread() jobs (NIfTI directories expand to multiple volumes; JSON sidecars are picked up when present). imread_kwargs is forwarded to imread; value selects the path column to read.

Assets as a wide table (one row per subject) by default; see assets().

scans(*, filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None, scan_uid: str | None = None, session_uid: str | None = None, subject_uid: str | None = None, scan_id: str | None = None, modality: str | None = None, orientation: str | None = None, resource_label: str | None = None, asset_slot: str | None = None, quality: str | None = None, series_description: str | None = None, source_batch_id: str | None = None, use_sqlite: bool | None = True, path_column: str = 'local_cache_path', get_image: bool = False, asset_type: str | None = None, download_scan_path: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, xnat_config: nvitk.db.xnat_config.XnatConnectionConfig | None = None, skip_existing_download: bool = True, imread_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None, cohort_id: str | bool | None = None) → pandas.DataFrame | Any¶

Query the scans table; with get_image=True, load volumes from path_column.

Write df to the table’s Parquet file and refresh catalog schema metadata.

Set build_sqlite_index=True to rebuild the SQLite index for table after the write.

upsert_table(table: str, df: pandas.DataFrame, *, key_columns: list[str] | None = None, provenance: dict[str, Any] | None = None, build_sqlite_index: bool = False) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Append df to the existing table and drop duplicates on key_columns (default: manifest keys).

Always reads the current Parquet (not SQLite) so sequential upserts without an intervening index rebuild do not drop recently written rows.

Returns the combined frame after write_table().

build_sqlite_index(*, tables: list[str] | None = None) → pathlib.Path¶

Rebuild the SQLite index from Parquet (all tables or the subset tables).

register_variables(entries: list[dict[str, Any]]) → None¶

Register variable definitions in the catalog manifest (clinical/image domains).

drop_table(name: str, *, remove_sqlite: bool = True) → None¶

Clear name from the catalog; optionally delete the SQLite DB file if remove_sqlite.

drop_all_tables(*, remove_sqlite: bool = True) → None¶

Clear every registered table; optionally remove the SQLite index file once at the end.

_read_table(definition: nvitk.db.catalog.TableDefinition, *, columns: list[str] | None = None, filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Read definition’s Parquet file (an empty typed frame if it doesn’t exist yet), coerce to the manifest schema, and apply filters.

_prepare_measurements(df: pandas.DataFrame, *, wide: bool, table_name: str, image_wide_single_variable: bool | None = None) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Resolve value_num/value_text into a unified value column and, if wide, pivot to one column per variable via _to_wide(); otherwise return the long frame with a fresh index.

_coerce_wide_measurement_dtypes(df: pandas.DataFrame, *, table_name: str) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Restore numeric dtypes on wide-pivoted measurement columns.

_resolve_measurement_values builds a single value series from value_num with a value_text fallback, which upcasts the whole series to object whenever any text variable is in the query. The subsequent pivot then leaves numeric variables (e.g. hematocrit) as object-dtype floats, and Patsy treats them as categoricals (Hematocrit[T.36.0], …). Coerce columns whose catalog value_kind is numeric back to float64.

_resolve_measurement_values(df: pandas.DataFrame) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Add a unified value column, preferring value_num and falling back to value_text row-wise where the numeric value is missing.

_to_wide(df: pandas.DataFrame, definition: nvitk.db.catalog.TableDefinition, *, image_wide_single_variable: bool | None = None) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Pivot a long measurement frame to wide form: one row per entity (wide_index_columns) and one column per composed key (region/variable/frame, see _compose_image_wide_keys() for image_measurements or _compose_wide_keys() otherwise), values from the value column.

_compose_wide_keys(df: pandas.DataFrame, key_columns: list[str]) → pandas.Series¶

Join key_columns per row with __ (skipping empty parts) to form wide-pivot column keys.

_relative_path(path: pathlib.Path) → str¶

path expressed relative to the dataset root, as a POSIX-style string for catalog storage.

nvitk.db.classify_scan(series_description: str | None, quality: str | None = None) → dict[str, Any] | None¶

Classify a scan by its series_description (and optional QC quality) into a {modality, orientation, sequence, ...} dict, matching BrainVIEW/VWI_BB, TOF/MRA, 4D-flow, resting- state fMRI, carotid QF, QSM/SWI, and other known sequence patterns in priority order. Returns None when the description matches nothing, or when quality is present and not "usable" (except for the BrainVIEW/VWI_BB case, which is quality-independent).

Open an xnat session for config, resolving credentials via _resolve_xnat_login(). Raises BackendUnavailableError if the xnat package isn’t installed, or an XNAT auth error (with a help message) if no usable credentials were found.

nvitk.db.sync_xnat_project(repo: nvitk.db.repo.DataRepo, config: nvitk.db.xnat_config.XnatConnectionConfig, *, catalog_path: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, subjects: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, subjects_file: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, id_type: str = 'subject', requested_sequences: str | Iterable[str] | None = None, download_root: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, download_dicoms: bool = False, download_niftis: bool = False, nifti_resource_label: str = 'NIFTI', nifti_download_root: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, skip_existing: bool = True, build_sqlite_index: bool = False, cohort_id: str | None = None, source_batch_id: str | None = None) → dict[str, pandas.DataFrame]¶

Sync an XNAT project’s subjects, sessions, scans, and (optionally) DICOM/NIfTI downloads into the dataset catalog tables. Resolves which subjects/sequences to pull via catalog_path/subjects/ subjects_file and requested_sequences (falling back to the project’s default sequence list), classifies each scan with nvitk.db.xnat_projects helpers, writes subjects/sessions/ scans/assets/subject_ids rows, enrolls synced subjects into cohort_id, and optionally downloads DICOM/NIfTI resources and rebuilds the SQLite index. Returns the written catalog frames.

Normalize server/project to non-empty strings via _coerce_xnat_identifier().

nvitk.db.load_xnat_profile(path: pathlib.Path | None = None) → dict[str, Any]¶

Load xnat profile dict from JSON or YAML.

If path is None, uses NVITK_XNAT_CONFIG if set, else the first existing file among ~/.config/nvitk/xnat.{yaml,yml,json}.

YAML requires PyYAML (pip install pyyaml or nvitk[xnat]).

nvitk.db.resolve_xnat_connection(profile: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, *, server: str | None = None, project: str | None = None, user: str | None = None, password: str | None = None, netrc_file: str | None = None, verify: bool | None = None, default_timeout: int | None = None) → XnatConnectionConfig¶

Build XnatConnectionConfig from profile, environment, and overrides.

Password resolution when not explicitly provided:

  1. profile['password'] (discouraged for shared files)

  2. password_env env var name in profile → os.environ

  3. password_keyring: true in profile → keyring for xnat:{server}

  4. XNAT_PASSWORD environment variable
